title: fix(service-automation): a flow write node's refusal is worded in the run's locale, as the record doors word it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XFgtJRPVDMB5VczqNK3rf7s)_

Fixes #25809

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

A refusal a flow's write node meets is now worded in the language of the person who started the run, as their own record save is.

The run already carries that language (`AutomationContext.locale`, seeded by the `/actions` door at `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` and by the trigger door). `resolveRunDataContext` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/runtime-identity.ts`), the one place that maps a run to the ObjectQL `context` its data nodes pass, dropped it. It now carries `locale` on both `runAs` arms (`RunDataContext.locale`). The engine's existing translation hook (`ObjectQL#validationMessageContext`, bridged to the i18n service) does the rest: an authored rule's `objects.OBJECT._validations.RULE.message`, the built-in catalog, a `DELETE_RESTRICTED` sentence's labels. The translated text reaches the caller through the path the inner-refusal ruling added: the crud node's catch arm puts it on `innerRefusal.message`, and the four doors emit it in the `FLOW_FAILED` details.

No second translation path: nothing in service-automation translates anything. A run no person started (record-change, schedule, webhook) has no locale and keeps the authored text, as before.

## Measurement — red first

`packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-write-refusal-locale.integration.test.ts`: a real kernel (ObjectQL + better-sqlite3), an object with an authored `script` rule, and a zh-CN bundle on the engine's i18n service. Each case first asserts the record door's own answer for the same write (`ql.insert` with `locale: 'zh-CN'` answers `金额不能为负数。`).

- At `cb0a2fcf4` (origin/main) plus the test alone: **6 failed / 2 passed (8)**. `create_record` and `update_record` returned `innerRefusal.message: "Amount must not be negative."` under both `runAs` arms; `delete_record` returned `This Account is still referenced by 1 Deal record(s) through “Account”. Delete or reassign them first.` (English labels). The two passing cases are the no-locale controls.
- With the fix (`447414c4`): **8 passed (8)**.

## Every flow write node, with a verdict

| Node | Verdict |
|:--|:--|
| `create_record` | Gap (measured red: authored rule message in English). Fixed. |
| `update_record` | Same gap (measured red). Fixed. |
| `delete_record` | Same gap on `DELETE_RESTRICTED`: the sentence named objects by their English labels (measured red). Fixed. |
| `get_record` | Read. ObjectQL reads `context.locale` only for refusal wording (validation messages, delete restriction), so a read has nothing to word. Carries the locale; no behaviour change. |
| lookup expander (`plugin.ts`, `setRecordExpander`) | Read through `resolveRunDataContext`; same as `get_record`. |
| `approval` / `approval_revise` (`plugin-approvals`) | Not a flow-generic data write: they write through the approval service under its own context, not through `resolveRunDataContext`. Out of this card's file surface; not measured. |
| `connector_action`, `http_*`, `notify`, `screen` | No ObjectQL write. |

All four data nodes take their context from `resolveRunDataContext` (`DATA_NODE_TYPES`), so the fix is one place and cannot drift between node types.

## Tests

- New: `flow-write-refusal-locale.integration.test.ts` — 8 cases: create / update / delete under `runAs: 'user'` and `'system'` in zh-CN, plus the no-locale control per arm.
- Ablation, one per arm, with the fix committed (`447414c4`), via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob moved; restore: blob == HEAD `d5d8492ba58e`, `git diff HEAD` empty). The subject is imported from source (`./plugin.js`), so no `dist/` leg applies.
  - delete `...(locale ? { locale } : {}),` (system arm): 3 failed / 5 passed — the three `runAs: 'system'` zh-CN cases.
  - delete `if (locale) out.locale = locale;` (user arm): 3 failed / 5 passed — the three `runAs: 'user'` zh-CN cases.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation test`: Test Files 203 passed (203), Tests 2667 passed (2667).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation typecheck`: exit 0 (incl. `check:test-typecheck`).
- `eslint --no-inline-config packages/services/service-automation`: exit 0.

## Gates (local subset)

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `ba44680f4` derives 68 families for this diff (3 paths). All 68 ran with exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: `68 derived, 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN` (exit 0).

- Two families answered exit 3 on the first pass for shallow-clone prerequisites, the known pair: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (re-run after fetching its fixture commit) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (re-run after a full `pnpm build`, lock VERDICT exit 0). Both re-ran to exit 0.
- The first 56 families ran at `447414c4` (the code at its final bytes, before the changeset commit); the 12 the changeset added to the derivation ran at `ba44680f4`.
- Every family CI runs is CI's verdict on this PR's check-runs; none is re-run here. `test:repo` and the repo-wide `pnpm lint` are CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- `AutomationContext.locale`'s docblock (`packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts`) lists its readers as the refusing `end` node and the `screen` executor; the data nodes are now a third reader. Not edited here: `packages/spec/**` is outside this claim's file surface. Carrier: none.
- Hooks fired by a flow's write now see the starter's `locale` on their session, as the same user's record-door write already gives them. Presentation only: no security middleware keys on it.
- The `/actions` door's half (`ec.locale` → `AutomationContext.locale`) and the details carriage (`flowFailureDetails`) were already on main and are unchanged; this PR pins the engine leg, where the gap was.
